question.text: An offshore fund in Master-Feeder Structure typically charges feeder-level management fee of:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 4.1.3, feeder funds in Master-Feeder charge only symbolic fixed amount (e.g., USD 1,000). **The Trap:** Real management fees are concentrated at master level. **Cross-Exam Context:** Key structural feature. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Highlight fee efficiency of Master-Feeder vs Parallel in client discussions.
